findings.label: G12 re-validation may miss construction errors
findings.description: G12 uses model_validate(model_dump()) which revalidates but may not catch errors that occur during initial construction but not during re-validation.

findings.label: G11 does not downgrade status
findings.description: G11 returns allowed=False when evidence is insufficient but the caller must downgrade status to REVIEW_REQUIRED; this behavioral split is non-obvious.

findings.label: G14 does not downgrade status
findings.description: G14 returns allowed=False when website requirements are not met but the caller must downgrade status to REVIEW_REQUIRED; this behavioral split is non-obvious.

findings.label: G5 duplicates blocklist instead of using config
findings.description: G5 hardcodes the blocklist instead of importing/configuring config.DEFAULT_SHARED_PLATFORM_DOMAINS; if config changes, G5 could drift.

findings.label: G9 missing run context may skip per-run limits
findings.description: G9 passes task_id to BudgetGuard but budget checks also verify per-run limits; if caller doesn't supply run_id context, per-run limits may not be enforced.

findings.label: G10 ancestry check requires correct task ancestry
findings.description: G10 checks task ancestry parameter but callers must supply correct task ancestry; if missing, cycle detection may fail.

findings.label: G6 accepts CACHED without text verification
findings.description: G6 accepts CACHED status without verifying text is meaningful; if cached result has text=None, it's rejected, but if text is present, content isn't verified.

findings.label: G8 may miss case-different duplicates
findings.description: G8 compares canonical URLs as strings; if same URL appears with different case (e.g., /About vs /about), they may be treated as different URLs.

findings.label: G7 aliases use substring matching
findings.description: G7 checks if alias appears in site_text, but callers might expect aliases to be exact matches rather than substring matches.

findings.label: G9 mock tests don't exercise full BudgetGuard
findings.description: G9 test mocks only implement minimal methods and return allow=True for page, LLM, and tool call checks; they don't verify actual budget exhaustion behavior.

findings.label: G3 quote length constraints not enforced by gate
findings.description: G3 doesn't enforce MIN_QUOTE_CHARS (15) and MAX_QUOTE_CHARS (400); callers must validate quote length before calling the gate.

findings.label: G12 re-validation may miss construction errors
findings.description: Using model_validate(model_dump()) revalidates but construction-time errors may not be caught if model was constructed with model_construct.
